Full Service Management

Our Full Service Management includes comprehensive oversight of your rental property, from marketing to maintenance.

✓Property marketing to attract quality tenants
✓Professional tenant screening and selection
✓Property showings, move-in and move-out processes
✓Lease preparation and security deposit handling
✓Addressing tenant concerns
✓Service and maintenance coordination
✓Legal notices and administrative duties
✓Lease renewals
✓Add-on services including semi-annual inspections

We take pride in our rigorous tenant selection and screening process, which significantly reduces the risk to you as a property owner. Our goal is to minimize risks and protect your investment.

Tenant Placement

Tenant Placement, Made Easy.

We find, vet, and lease the right renter. You handle the day-to-day.

✓Property marketing to attract quality tenants
✓Tenant screening: thorough vetting including credit and background checks, proof of employment, and income verification for all adults 18+
✓Rent and deposit collection: collect the full first month's rent and security deposit on your behalf
✓Lease preparation: draft lease agreements to protect your investment
✓Tenant possession: facilitate the transfer of possession and keys
✓Security deposit management: owners hold the security deposit in a non-interest-bearing account

Frequently Asked Questions

To apply, click the "Apply Now" button on the listing. Each adult (18+) must submit a separate, fully completed application. A $50 non-refundable application fee is required per applicant. Applicants must provide a valid photo ID and proof of income.

Applications are typically processed within 3 business days, provided all required documents are submitted and all applicants meet the screening criteria (credit, rental history, background check).

Pet acceptance varies by property. Please carefully review the listing for specific pet policies before applying.

All applications are reviewed on a case-by-case basis. General qualification criteria include:

  • Income: Gross monthly household income should be at least 3.5× the monthly rent. If using a qualified co-signer, household income must be at least 2.5× the rent.
  • Credit Score: Minimum score of 580 per applicant.
  • Criminal History: Evaluated on a case-by-case basis, considering recency, severity, frequency, and type of offense.
  • Rental History: Reviewed for issues such as late payments, lease violations, damages, or unpaid balances.
  • Credit History: Reviewed for account standing, collections, charge-offs, and bankruptcies.

Contact us at (231) 346-4102 or email info@northlandpm.com. We look forward to assisting you!
